title: The Rule with an Expiration Date
fact_notes: 人物・町・行事・数値や結果は架空の事例。実在の統計や研究結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり、実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: A fictional town council received complaints from residents about bicycles being left in a narrow entrance to a public building.
sentences.ja: 架空の町の議会は公共施設の狭い入口に自転車が置かれているという住民の苦情を受けた。

sentences.en: Several visitors said that parked bicycles had made it difficult for them to enter the building with large bags or mobility equipment.
sentences.ja: 大きな荷物や移動補助器具を持って施設に入る際、駐輪された自転車が妨げになったと数人の来訪者が語った。

sentences.en: The council proposed a new rule prohibiting bicycle parking near the entrance during business hours to keep the path clear.
sentences.ja: 議会は通路を確保するため営業時間中の入口付近の駐輪を禁止する新ルールを提案した。

sentences.en: However, some residents worried that the rule would create difficulties because convenient alternative parking was not yet available nearby.
sentences.ja: しかし近くに便利な代替駐輪場所がまだないので、ルールが問題を生むと懸念する住民もいた。

sentences.en: Instead of insisting on a permanent rule immediately, a council member suggested introducing the restriction for a limited trial period.
sentences.ja: 直ちに恒久ルールを主張する代わりに、議員は制限を期間限定で試すことを提案した。

sentences.en: Under the proposal, the temporary rule would expire after three months unless the council explicitly decided to extend or modify it.
sentences.ja: 提案では議会が明示的に延長または修正を決めない限り、暫定ルールは3か月後に失効する。

sentences.en: The council also agreed to identify a temporary alternative parking area and publish information about how residents could submit comments.
sentences.ja: 議会は暫定的な代替駐輪場を特定し、住民が意見を提出する方法も公表することに合意した。

sentences.en: These arrangements were intended to help the council evaluate the rule rather than treat its initial adoption as a final judgment.
sentences.ja: これらの取り決めは最初の採択を最終判断と扱わず、議会がルールを評価するためのものだった。

sentences.en: During the trial, employees at the public building recorded whether its entrance remained clear and whether visitors reported new difficulties.
sentences.ja: 試行中、公共施設の職員は入口が確保されているか、来訪者が新たな困難を報告したか記録した。

sentences.en: Residents who traveled by bicycle were invited to explain how the distance to the alternative parking area affected their daily journeys.
sentences.ja: 自転車で移動する住民に、代替駐輪場までの距離が日常の移動にどう影響するか説明してもらった。

sentences.en: Several people suggested moving the temporary parking area closer to a different entrance that had previously been overlooked.
sentences.ja: 数人が以前見落としていた別の入口の近くへ暫定駐輪場を移すよう提案した。

sentences.en: The council examined the suggestion because a less inconvenient solution might achieve the same goal of keeping the original entrance accessible.
sentences.ja: 不便さの少ない方法でも当初の入口を利用しやすく保つという同じ目的を達成できるかもしれないので、議会は提案を検討した。

sentences.en: Before the expiration date, the council held a public meeting and presented a summary of the information collected during the trial.
sentences.ja: 失効日前に、議会は公開会議を開き、試行中に集めた情報の要約を提示した。

sentences.en: Members agreed that keeping the path clear remained important, but they also recognized that the alternative parking arrangements could be improved.
sentences.ja: 議員は通路の確保が重要であり続けることに同意しつつ、代替駐輪場の取り決めを改善できると認めた。

sentences.en: The council adopted a revised rule together with a new parking location rather than simply renew the original restriction without discussion.
sentences.ja: 議会は議論なしに元の制限を更新するのでなく、新たな駐輪場所とともに修正ルールを採択した。

sentences.en: It also published its reasons so that people could understand how the evidence and public comments had influenced the decision.
sentences.ja: 証拠と住民の意見が決定にどう影響したか理解できるよう、理由も公表した。

sentences.en: A temporary rule is not necessarily suitable for every problem, especially when consistent protection must be maintained without interruption.
sentences.ja: 暫定ルールがすべての問題に適するとは限らない。特に途切れず一貫した保護を維持する必要がある場合はそうだ。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, when a policy involves uncertainty and its effects can be monitored, a planned review may help decision makers detect unexpected consequences.
sentences.ja: それでも政策に不確実性があり効果を監視できるとき、計画的な見直しは予想外の影響の発見に役立つ場合がある。

sentences.en: An expiration date can create an obligation to reconsider a decision rather than allow a temporary response to continue through simple neglect.
sentences.ja: 失効日は一時的な対応が単なる放置で続くのを許さず、決定を再検討する義務を生み得る。

sentences.en: In this fictional example, public participation was valuable not merely at the moment when the rule was proposed but throughout its implementation and revision.
sentences.ja: この架空の例では住民参加は提案時だけでなく実施と修正の全過程で価値を持った。

options: Bicycles obstructed the entrance to a public building.
The town had forbidden all forms of cycling.
A public meeting room had closed permanently.
Visitors had removed every bicycle rack.
questions.explanation_ja: 入口付近の駐輪が通行の妨げだった。

questions.prompt: Why did some residents oppose the initial proposal?
options: They believed the entrance should always be blocked.
They had no interest in public buildings.
Convenient alternative parking was not yet available.
The council had already provided several nearby alternatives.
questions.explanation_ja: 便利な代替駐輪場所がなかった。

questions.prompt: When would the temporary rule expire without further action?
options: After three years.
At the end of each business day.
As soon as the first comment was received.
After three months.
questions.explanation_ja: 延長・修正の決定がなければ3か月後に失効。

questions.prompt: Why did the council arrange ways to gather public comments?
options: To prevent residents from discussing the rule.
To help evaluate how the temporary rule worked.
To make the original policy impossible to change.
To avoid providing an alternative parking area.
questions.explanation_ja: 試行の結果を評価するため。

questions.prompt: What information did building employees record?
options: Every cyclist's personal medical history.
The number of council members at home.
Whether the entrance remained clear and visitors reported difficulties.
Future plans for all public buildings.
questions.explanation_ja: 入口の通行状況と新たな困難。

options: Moving temporary parking closer to another entrance.
Closing the original entrance forever.
Removing all places for parking bicycles.
Extending the trial without collecting evidence.
questions.explanation_ja: 別入口付近への駐輪場所の移転。

questions.prompt: What did the council ultimately adopt?
options: An unchanged restriction without discussion.
A revised rule and a new parking location.
A permanent ban on bicycles across the town.
A rule preventing public comments.
questions.explanation_ja: 修正ルールと新駐輪場所。

questions.prompt: Why did it publish the reasons for its decision?
options: To guarantee nobody would ever disagree.
To conceal the results of the trial.
To discourage future review of rules.
To explain how evidence and public feedback shaped the outcome.
questions.explanation_ja: 根拠と意見が判断にどう関与したか説明。

options: Failure to give necessary attention.
A deliberate extension after careful review.
An important public meeting.
A written explanation of a rule.
questions.explanation_ja: 注意を払わず放置すること。

questions.prompt: Which statement best reflects the passage?
options: Every public policy must automatically expire after three months.
Temporary rules always provide adequate protection.
In suitable circumstances, a review deadline can encourage evidence-based revision and public participation.
Public participation should end as soon as a rule is adopted.
questions.explanation_ja: 期限付き見直しが根拠と参加による修正を促す場合がある。
